title: Duplicate-request sampling and tenant isolation for canary duplication pipeline
creator: Ava Chen
description: Problem: We need a safe, tenant-aware mechanism to duplicate a subset of production requests to candidate model variants for canary evaluation without meaningfully increasing cost or risking noisy cross-tenant side-effects. Existing gateway-level fanout duplicates at 100% or simple percentage sampling and lacks per-tenant quotas, request isolation, and budget enforcement. Goal: Implement a duplication pipeline that supports stratified sampling, per-tenant budget caps and isolation (no leaking sensitive headers or state), per-route configuration, and automatic throttling when duplication cost approaches budget. Non-goals: full traffic-splitting A/B engine (that is tracked in a separate PM epic), long-term storage of mirrored payloads (we'll keep short-lived logs), or per-model training data ingestion features. Success criteria: canary duplication running in prod for 3 customers with distinct budgets, <5% additional tail latency on ingress, and no cross-tenant data exposure incidents.
acceptance_criteria: Route-level duplicate configuration with sampling weight (0-100%) and stratification by route/tenant/region
Per-tenant duplication budget config (tokens/month or request-count) that enforces throttling when exceeded
Duplication path removes or redacts PII headers and suppresses side-effect headers (Auth, X-Forwarded-For, Cookies) by default
Isolation mode: duplicated requests run in a bounded runtime sandbox with CPU/GPU request quotas to prevent noisy neighbor effects
End-to-end test harness (local + staging) that simulates heavy duplication and validates throttles and rollback triggers
Telemetry: per-route and per-tenant duplication rate, cost estimate, latency delta, error delta compared to production path
Auto-fallback policy: if duplication-induced error rate or latency delta exceeds configured thresholds for 5m, automatically pause duplicates and create an alert
comments: 2026-02-15 - Ava Chen: Created ticket after monthly ops review; observed two customers had unbounded mirroring experiments that drove costs. Added initial scope.

2026-02-18 - Miguel Alvarez: Spike notes attached to PRD. Evaluated two designs: gateway-level duplication vs sidecar duplication. Favor sidecar because it isolates traffic duplication from gateway and allows per-tenant sandboxing. See design doc link.

2026-02-25 - Emily Park (SRE): SRE feedback: require a hard circuit-breaker on duplication path at the per-cluster level and an emergency kill switch in the console. Also require audit logs for duplication enable/disable events.

2026-03-02 - Miguel Alvarez: Implemented prototype sidecar that reads k8s annotations for sampling weight and tenant budget. Prototype validated in staging with synthetic load; observed ~3% median latency increase on ingress when duplication active at 20% sampling.
2026-03-05 - Design review: Riley Patel requested UX copy to clearly label duplicated responses in console and to add a 'sandboxed headers' explanation in the rollout modal.

2026-03-10 - QA: Added test cases for header redaction, per-tenant quota exhaustion, and auto-pause behaviour. Found race condition when two duplication configs for same route are updated concurrently; mitigation plan in comments.
2026-03-10 - Miguel Alvarez: Marking Q2 rollout candidate and scheduling canary customers. Next steps: finish k8s operator config for budgets and finalize alerting thresholds.
rollback_policy: Auto-pause duplicates if duplication.error_delta_percentage > 2% for 5 continuous minutes OR duplication.latency_delta_p95 > 100ms for 5 continuous minutes. Auto-resume only after manual review or a zero-error window of 30 minutes. Events generate PagerDuty alert and create a runbook incident ticket.
implementation_notes: Use sidecar duplication to attach to workload pods so we can enforce per-tenant CPU/GPU quotas via cgroups and limit device access
Sampling: support stratified reservoir sampling per tenant to ensure low-volume tenants are still represented in small sample sizes
Cost accounting: estimate token-equivalent cost at duplication time and decrement tenant budget atomically; if budget insufficient, fall back to 0% duplication for that tenant
Redaction: default redaction list in config (Authorization, Cookie, Set-Cookie, X-Real-IP). Allow opt-in additional redaction via tenant config
Telemetry: add a lightweight tracing span for duplication path and tag spans with duplication.enabled and duplication.sample_rate
Emergency kill: Console button should call admin API to set global duplication.disable=true; make that action auditable in audit logs
